sketch-1.title: Start from one working badge program
sketch-1.bodyMarkdown:
The welcome table needs a small badge program. Before splitting the app into files, start with one version whose behavior is easy to understand:

```python
def clean_name(text):
    return text.strip().title()

def make_badge(name, role):
    clean_role = role.strip().upper()
    return f"{clean_role} badge: {name}"

raw_name = input()
role = input()
name = clean_name(raw_name)
badge = make_badge(name, role)
print(badge)
```

The project will **refactor this same behavior cumulatively**. First move name cleanup to `names.py`. Then move badge formatting to `badges.py`. Next document the helper contracts. Finally add a small `messages.py` helper for the welcome line.

Each project step starts from the exact previous solution, so you never restart from an unrelated file.
